# authwise_guard_resource (Data Source)

A routed target in a Guard network that is not a node: a subnet, a host or an application. The nodes that serve it are managed by `authwise_guard_resource_nodes`. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String)
- `config` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `guard_resource_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `kind` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `network_id` (String)
- `serving_node_ids` (List of String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
